subject: Quick sync on Q3 roadmap?
body: Hi, can we set up a call to discuss the Q3 roadmap? I'm free next Monday at 2pm. Let's include Raj (raj@acme.com) too.

expected.draft_criteria: Acknowledges the sender and confirms/responds to the proposed Monday 2pm meeting request.

subject: Need to move tomorrow's 10am meeting
body: Something came up - can we push tomorrow's 10am meeting to 3pm instead? Same attendees.

expected.draft_criteria: Acknowledges the reschedule request and confirms new proposed time of 3pm.

subject: Cancelling Friday's design review
body: Hey team, I need to cancel Friday's design review. We'll reschedule once the mockups are ready.

expected.draft_criteria: Acknowledges the cancellation of Friday's design review politely.

subject: What's your availability next week?
body: We'd like to schedule your performance review sometime next week. What times work for you?

expected.draft_criteria: Acknowledges the request and responds with availability or asks for options.

subject: URGENT: Production outage - need fix by EOD
body: Prod is down for all EU customers. We need a hotfix deployed by end of day today. Please own the rollback plan and report back by 5pm.

expected.draft_criteria: Acknowledges the urgency and confirms the action items (hotfix, rollback plan, 5pm report) will be handled.

subject: Login issues since yesterday
body: I've been unable to log in to my account since yesterday. It just shows a spinner. Can you help?

expected.draft_criteria: Acknowledges the login issue and confirms it will be investigated.

subject: Question about pricing tiers
body: Hi, could you tell me the difference between the Pro and Enterprise pricing tiers?

expected.draft_criteria: Acknowledges the question about Pro vs Enterprise pricing tiers.

subject: Approval needed: $12k vendor contract
body: Please review and approve the attached $12k vendor contract with Northwind Traders by Thursday.

action_items.task: Review and approve $12k Northwind Traders contract

expected.draft_criteria: Acknowledges the approval request and the Thursday deadline.

subject: Heads up: office closed Monday
body: Just a heads up that the office will be closed this Monday for maintenance. Please plan to work remotely.

expected.draft_criteria: Brief acknowledgement that the office closure notice was received.

subject: Can I upgrade my plan mid-cycle?
body: If I upgrade my subscription mid-cycle, will I be charged a pro-rated amount?

expected.draft_criteria: Acknowledges the mid-cycle upgrade / pro-ration question.

subject: Following up on last week's proposal
body: Just following up - did you get a chance to review the proposal I sent last Tuesday?

expected.draft_criteria: Acknowledges the follow-up on the proposal sent last Tuesday.

subject: This Week in AI - Issue #147
body: This week: new model releases, funding rounds, and our top 5 reads. Unsubscribe anytime.

expected.draft_criteria: No response should be drafted for a newsletter.

subject: You've won a free iPhone!!!
body: Congratulations! Click here to claim your free iPhone before it's too late!

expected.draft_criteria: No response should be drafted for spam.

subject: Contract review meeting + prep doc
body: Let's meet Wednesday at 11am to review the vendor contract. Before then, please prepare a summary of the key risk clauses.

action_items.task: Prepare summary of key risk clauses

expected.draft_criteria: Acknowledges both the Wednesday 11am meeting and the request to prepare the risk-clause summary beforehand.

subject: Let's catch up sometime
body: We should catch up soon, it's been a while. Let me know if you're free.

expected.draft_criteria: Acknowledges the informal catch-up request without inventing a specific date or time.

subject: Your password was changed
body: This is a confirmation that your account password was successfully changed on Aug 5, 2026. If this wasn't you, contact support immediately.

expected.draft_criteria: Brief acknowledgement; no action items should be invented.
